_doc: Rung-2 checks for /garden. Each rule is a correction that should never need making twice. scope/exclude are globs over tracked files (* crosses folders). 'forbid' = pattern must not appear on any line; 'require' = a file whose text matches 'when' must also match 'pattern'. Structural checks (findings schema, skill parity) live in lint.py and take their allowlists from 'allow'. Add a rule whenever /garden promotes a correction to rung 2, and a row to corrections.md.
